# Ocean Breeze Animal Hospital - Jensen Beach Veterinary Clinic

> A full-service veterinary hospital in Jensen Beach, FL offering comprehensive pet care including surgery, dentistry, wellness, boarding, and grooming with state-of-the-art diagnostic technology.

Ocean Breeze Animal Hospital is located at 1553 NE Jensen Beach Blvd in Jensen Beach, Florida, serving the Hutchinson Island area. The practice provides a wide range of veterinary services for companion animals with modern facilities and advanced equipment including digital X-ray and laser therapy technology.

## Core Services

- [Services](https://www.jensenbeachveterinary.com/veterinarian-services): Overview of veterinary services offered at Ocean Breeze
- [Animal Wellness & Vaccinations](https://www.jensenbeachveterinary.com/veterinarian-services/wellness-vaccinations): Wellness care and vaccination services for pets of all ages
- [Animal Surgery](https://www.jensenbeachveterinary.com/veterinarian-services/surgery): Surgical procedures and surgical care services for animals
- [Animal Dentistry](https://www.jensenbeachveterinary.com/veterinarian-services/dentistry): Dental care and treatment services for dogs and cats
- [Pet Boarding & Grooming](https://www.jensenbeachveterinary.com/veterinarian-services/boarding-grooming): Full-service pet boarding and grooming at Ocean Breeze
- [Allergy & Dermatology](https://www.jensenbeachveterinary.com/veterinarian-services/allergy-dermatology): Allergy and dermatology treatment services for companion animals
- [Pet Nutrition & Weight Management](https://www.jensenbeachveterinary.com/veterinarian-services/nutrition-weight-management): Pet nutrition and weight management services at Ocean Breeze
- [Pet Behavioral Counseling](https://www.jensenbeachveterinary.com/veterinarian-services/behavioral-counseling): Professional behavioral counseling to address pet behavior issues
- [Animal Laser Therapy](https://www.jensenbeachveterinary.com/veterinarian-services/laser-therapy): Laser surgery and laser therapy services for pets
- [Digital X-Ray Technology](https://www.jensenbeachveterinary.com/veterinarian-services/digital-x-ray-technology): Digital X-ray diagnostic imaging technology for pet care
